basis.thirdPartyPlayer: Trailers open in YouTube or the system browser. Build 19 and compatible updates have no embedded player or player advertising/data collection. Legacy player processing remains disclosed in the public privacy policy for older app versions.
basis.deviceId: Aggregated disclosure is linked because YepWatch’s room-allowance installation identifier identifies a guest alongside their room participation. Expo’s separate random installation ID is not linked to an account, but Apple aggregates both uses into Device ID.
basis.crashData: Expo update failures and short launch errors are used for functionality/diagnostics, without account linkage or tracking. No Expo Observe SDK is installed.
basis.contactAndSupport: Names identify room participants; optional support and account-support correspondence can include email and customer-support data. YepWatch’s GoodWatch account link does not expose the GoodWatch email or password.
basis.coarseLocation: Selected streaming region only; no location permission or embedded-player location processing in build 19.
basis.roomIdeas: Private room-authored ideas and optional search prompts are data collection. They are not a broad public UGC feed; Apple’s age-questionnaire UGC definition covers broad distribution, unlike its privacy data category.
basis.publication: Each category is saved in App Store Connect. Publish and fresh readback are tracked separately in the release record.

externalTrailers: Trailers open in YouTube or the system browser. Build 19 and compatible updates have no embedded player or player advertising/data collection. Legacy player processing remains disclosed in the public privacy policy for older app versions.
